s: Din tepillin bipratut, ubo m"b seipim: veachar shellabash tallit metzuyyetzet — yaniach tepillin miyyad, kede sheyyihyu alayv bishat qeriat shema utepilla, shekkol haqqore qeriat shema belo tepillin — keillu meid edut sheqer al atzmo, shehu omer: "uqeshartam leot ku'", veeno meqayyem:

Hammannichin hattallit vekis hattepillin letok kis echad — yizzaharu lekattechilla shello yannichu kis hattepillin lemala min hattallit, kede shello yipga behattepillin qodem sheyyipga behattallit, veyitztarek lehaabir al hammitzvot, kede lehitattep behatztzitzit qodem hanachat hattepillin, shehare mitzvat tzitzit hi tedira shennoheget ben bechol ben beshabbat veyom-tob utepillin enan nohagin beshabbat veyom-tob, vetadir qodem lesheeno tadir:

Veim lo nizhar bazeh vehinniach kis hattepillin lemala min hattallit — ap-al-pi-ken yitattep techilla behattallit qodem sheyyaniach tepillin, veen zeh kemaabir al hammitzvot, kevan shehattepillin hem mekussim umunnachim adayin betok kisam. Abal im hattepillin hem begilluy umunnachin belo kisan lemala min hattallit — asur lehaabir al hammitzva shennizdammena leyado, vetzarik sheyyaniach hattepillin qodem atipat hattallit:

Veken im tepillin mezummanim beyado veen mezumman adayin lepanayv hattallit — en tzarik lehamtin al hattallit kede lehaqdimo lahanachat tepillin, ella yaniach tepillin miyyad ukesheyyabiu lo tallit — yitattep bo, mippene sheen mashhin et hammitzva, ap-al-pi sheyyesh lomar sheyyaaseh achar-kak hammitzva yoter min hammubchar — mitzva bishatah chabiba:
Veyesh omerim shehanachat tepillin tzarik lehaqdim laatipat hatztzitzit, mippene shehattepillin yesh bahem qedushsha yetera veqibbul ol malkut shamayim:

Veharotzeh latzet yede kullam — yilbash tallit qatan bebeto qodem halikato lebet hakkeneset, veachar-kak yaniach hattepillin miyyad gam ken bebeto qodem halikato lebet hakkeneset, veaz yelek lebet hakkeneset labush betzitzit umuktar bitpillin kamboar hattaam bazzohar, vesham bebet hakkeneset yitattep betallit gadol. Veap im nizdammen leyado hattallit gadol beodo bebeto qodem sheheniach tepillin — en tzarik lehitattep bo bebeto, veeno kemaabir al hammitzva shennizdammena leyado, kevan sheen bedato kelal lelobsho kan:

Vehaolam nahagu lehitattep ap betallit gadol bebeto qodem hanachat hattepillin, veachar-kak meniach tepillin veholek lebet hakkeneset. Ubimqomot shennokrim metzuyim barechob — en mitattepim betallit gadol ad boo lachatzar bet hakkeneset:

Ap-al-pi shemmiddina digmara muttar lelek bitpillin megullin bimboot hamtunnapot apillu yesh sham tinnup lehedya, mikkol maqom im yodea bevadday sheyyelek derek meboot hamtunnapot — lo yaniach tepillin ad boo lachatzar bet hakkeneset, vesham yaniach tepillin qodem kenisato lebet hakkeneset leqayyem dibre hazzohar. Veyesh nohagin lehaniach tepillin babbayit ulekassotam bishat halika bimboot hamtunnapot. Veken nakon:

Hara"sh za"l haya mebarek birkot hashshachar ad "oter yisrael betipara", vehaya meniach tepillin veachar-kak mebarek "oter yisrael betipara", kede litten shebach vehodaya bibraka zo gam al hattepillin, shehem niqraim "peer", shenneemar: "peereka chabosh aleka":

Im echad hitqashsher et atzmo biqnas lelek laamirat tehillim qodem or habboqer, veachar-kak rotzeh lachazor bo mippene sheeno yakol lelek lebet hakkeneset melubbash betzitzit utepillin — hareshut beyado lachazor bo upatur miqqenas. Umikkol maqom tzarik hattara lenidro (ayyen beyoreh dea siman ralab vesiman rig):

Yekavven bahanachat hattepillin shetztzivvanu haqqadosh-baruk-hu liktob arba parashiyyot ellu, sheyyesh bahem yichud shemo vitziat mitzrayim, velahanichan al hazzeroa keneged halleb veal harosh keneged hammoach, kede shennizkor nissim veniplaot sheasa immanu, shehem morim al yichudo, vaasher lo hakkoach vehammemshala laasot baelyonim ubattachtonim kirtzono. Vishabed lehaqqadosh-baruk-hu hanneshama shehi bammoach vegam taavot umachshebot libbo laabodato yitbarek, veal yede hanachat tepillin yizkor et habbore yitbarek veyamit hanaotayv:

Battechilla yaniach tepillin shel yad, veachar-kak tepillin shel rosh. Veim paga beshel rosh techilla — yaabor al otah mitzva veyaniach shel yad techilla, kevan sheqqedimat shel yad leshel rosh hu min hattora, shehare battechilla neemar: "uqeshartam leot al yadeka" veachar-kak "vehayu letotapot vego'", lepikak en mashgichin al haabarat hammitzva bazeh:

Tepillin shel yad utepillin shel rosh — enan mitzva achat, ella hen shette mitzvot sheen meakkebot zo et zo, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman kv, ulepikak kol achat veachat teuna beraka bipne atzmah. Umippene sheasur lebarek beraka sheenah tzerika, im epshar liptor et atzmo bibraka achat — en lebarek shette berakot. Ulepikak tiqqenu chakamim sheyyismok hanachat tepillin shel rosh lahanachat tepillin shel yad beli shum hepseq dibbur benetayim, kede shettaaleh habberaka sheyyebarek al shel yad gam litpillin shel rosh:

Vetiqqenu chakamim lebarek od beraka acheret al tepillin shel rosh, lepi shehi chashuba vehi iqqar hammitzva, veyesh bah yoter qedushsha sheyyesh bah arbaa battim vehashshi"n, laken mippene chashibutah qoba beraka leatzmah:

Nosach birkat tepillin shel yad: "asher qiddeshanu bemitzvotayv vetzivvanu lehaniach tepillin". Venosach birkat tepillin shel rosh: "asher qiddeshanu bemitzvotayv vetzivvanu al mitzvat tepillin". Veyomar: "lehaniach" — beqamatz hahe"a, velo bepattach shehu leshon aziba, kemo shekkatub: "achikem haechad hannichu itti", "tepillin" — hallame"d bedagesh, lehorot al chesron lame"d hashsheniyya, lepi shehattepillin hu leshon pelila vehokacha, shehattepillin hen edut vehokacha shehashshekina shora alenu, kemo shekkatub: "verau kol amme haaretz ki shem hvy"h niqra aleka", vedareshu chakamim: ellu tepillin shebbarosh:

Yomar: "al mitzvat" — bepattach tachat havva"v, shehu leshon yachid, velo yomar becholam, shehu leshon rabbim, shehare lo nittaqqena beraka zo ella litpillin shel rosh bilbad, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman kv:

Kol birkot hammitzvot tzarik lebarek otan qodem hatchalat asiyyat hammitzva, lepikak al tepillin shel yad yebarek achar hanacha al haqqibboret qodem haqqeshira, sheqqeshiratah zo hi hatchalat asiyyatah, veal tepillin shel rosh yebarek achar hanacha al harosh qodem sheyyehaddeqenna heteb al rosho, shehahidduq hu hatchalat asiyyatah. Abal lo yebarek qodem hanacha al haqqibboret o al harosh, mippene shetztzarik leqareb habberaka laasiyyat hammitzva ulesomkan zo lezo bekol mah deepshar:

Kebar bearnu sheasur lehapsiq bedibbur ben tepillin shel yad litpillin shel rosh. Veim hipsiq — azay en birkat tepillin shel yad ola litpillin shel rosh, vetzarik lebarek al tepillin shel rosh shette berakot: "lehaniach tepillin" ve"al mitzvat tepillin":

Bammeh debarim amurim? Kesheddibber meinyanim sheenam letzorek hanachat tepillin, abal im hipsiq beinyanim shehem nitzrakim lo lahanachat hattepillin — en zeh hepseq, veen tzarik lebarek al tepillin shel rosh ella "al mitzvat tepillin" bilbad:

Abal lekattechilla asur lehapsiq ben birkat tepillin shel yad lahanachat tepillin shel rosh apillu bidbarim shehen letzorek hanachat tepillin, ella im ken i epshar beinyan acher. Vaapillu liqrotz beenayv velirmoz beetzbeotayv — asur ben tepillin shel yad litpillin shel rosh:

Im shama qaddish o bareku o qedushsha ben tepillin shel yad litpillin shel rosh — lo yapsiq laanot im hatztzibbur, ella shoteq veshomea umekavven lemah shehatztzibbur omerim, kemo sheyyitbaer hattaam besiman (q"t) [q"d]. Veim pasaq veana — have hepseq ben birkat tepillin shel yad lahanachat tepillin shel rosh, vetzarik lebarek al tepillin shel rosh shette berakot:

Asur lehapsiq ben tepillin shel yad litpillin shel rosh apillu bemaqom sheen gorem lebarek shette berakot al tepillin shel rosh, kegon otam hamnnichin tepillin bechol hammoed belo beraka, veken hammenichin tepillin derabbenu tam — tzerikim litkop velismok tepillin shel yad litpillin shel rosh beli shum hepseq sicha benetayim, shenneemar: "vehaya leka leot al yadeka ulezikkaron ben eneka", velo neemar "vehayu lezikkaron ben eneka", ella mashma sheshtehem nechshabim lahavaya vaasiyya achat, mechamat shetztzarik letokpan zo achar zo belo shum hepseq. Abal mikkol maqom, muttar laanot qaddish uqedushsha ubareku veamen al kol habberakot ben tepillin shel yad litpillin shel rosh bitpillin derabbenu tam, o bechol hammoed mi sheeno mebarek alehem, kevan sheeno gorem lebarek beraka sheena tzerika al tepillin shel rosh:

Veyesh omerim shelleolam en tepillin shel rosh teuna shette berakot, ki im beraka achat kishar kol hammitzvot, velo nittaqqena birkat "al mitzvat tepillin" litpillin shel rosh, ella im ken hipsiq bedibbur ben birkat tepillin shel yad lahanachat tepillin shel rosh, abal im lo hipsiq benetayim — azay ola birkat "lehaniach tepillin" shebberak al tepillin shel yad gam litpillin shel rosh. Vehamminhag beellu haaratzot kassebara harishona. Umikkol maqom leravcha demilleta — tob lomar achar birkat "al mitzvat tepillin": "baruk shem kebod malkuto leolam vaed", shekken tzarik lomar achar kol beraka lebattala, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman rv. Veken im hu mebarek shette berakot al tepillin shel rosh, kegon shehesiach ben tepillin shel yad litpillin shel rosh — yomar achar beraka hashsheniyya: "baruk shem kebod malkuto leolam vaed", shellepi sebara haacharona shennitbaer besamuk hayeta beraka rishona lebattala. Ubeet shemmebarek beraka rishona al tepillin shel rosh, shehi birkat "lehaniach tepillin" — tob lemashmesh bitpillin shel yad bishat beraka, mishshum shehammishmush hu chashub keillu menichah akshav al haqqibboret, veal zeh shayyak lebarek "lehaniach tepillin":

Kebar bearnu debirkat "lehaniach tepillin" ola gam ken leshel rosh, al ken yesh lemaet hahepseq benehem bekol mah deepshar, velaken lo yikrok haretzua sebib hazzeroa ad leachar sheyyaniach tepillin shel rosh, kevan shekkerika zo enah raq minhag beolma veenah biklal hammitzva, al ken tob leacher otah. Vehaari"y za"l haya noheg likrok kerika zo qodem hanachat tepillin shel rosh, mippene shehu sober shekkerika zo hi mikkelal hammitzva, ulepikak en zo hepseq kelal:
Yesh mi sheomer sheasur lehotzi et hattepillin shel rosh mehattiq ad shettehe hattepillin shel yad munachat kebar al haqqibboret, mehattaam hayyadua lammaskilim:

Veap im shettehen munnachot lepanayv chutz lattiq — lo yetaqqen liptoach et hattepillin shel rosh ad achar hanachat tepillin shel yad, dikshennotel et hattepillin shel rosh beyado kede lepotchah veeno menichah miyyad — hare hu maabir al hammitzva:

Yesh omerim sheyyaniach hattepillin shel yad meyushshab utepillin shel rosh meummad, mittaam shennitbaer bazzohar. Abal bimdinot ellu nohagin lehaniach shettehen meummad. (Vire shamayim yotze et kullam) ulekattechilla tob linhog shettehe hahanacha al haqqibboret meyushshab, vehabberaka vehaqqeshira al haqqibboret yihyeh meummad, kemo shennitbaer besiman ch shekkol birkot hammitzvot tzarik lebarek meummad:

Kol dabar shebbaale haqqabbala vehazzohar choleqim im haggemara o happoseqim hannimshakim achar haggemara — hallek achar haggemara o happoseqim hannimshakim achareha. Umikkol maqom, im baale haqqabbala machamirim — yesh lehachamir gam ken, abal en anu yekolim lakop et hatztzibbur lehachamir. Veken kol dabar shello huzkar kelal baggemara uposeqim ap-al-pi shennizkar baqqabbala — en anu yekolim lakop et hatztzibbur linhog ken:

Mi shechalatz et tepillayv vehaya bedato shello yachazor lahanichan ad leachar zeman merubbeh, kemo shettayim o shalosh shaot, veachar-kak nimlak lachazor velahanichan miyyad — tzarik lachazor ulebarek alehem. Abal im bishat chalitzat hattepillin haya dato lachazor velahanicham miyyad, vechozer umenichan miyyad — en tzarik lachazor ulebarek alehem, mippene shekkebar nipteru babberaka shebberak alehem keshehenichan bepaam rishona:

Bammeh debarim amurim? Shello asa tzerakayv ben chalitzat hattepillin lahanachatan paam sheniyya, abal im asa tzerakayv benetayim, kevan shebbaet hahi lo haya yakol lehaniach tepillin — im ken eno moil kelum mah shehaya bedato lachazor velahanichan miyyad, velaken tzarik lachazor ulebarek al hanacha sheniyya keillu lo haya bedato kelal bishat chalitzatan lachazor velahanichan miyyad:

Im nishmetu hattepillin mimmeqom hanachatan, sheyyitbaer besiman kaz, umemashmesh bahen lehachaziran limqoman — tzarik lachazor ulebarek alehen, dekevan shennishmetu shello middato — eno moil kelum mah shebbedato lachazor velahanichan al meqoman. Veim eno machazir ella achat mehen — mebarek kemo sheeno meniach ella tepilla achat, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman kv. Abal im hu beatzmo hezizan mimmeqoman vehaya bedato lachazor velahanichan al meqoman miyyad, umachaziran al meqomo miyyad — en tzarik lachazor ulebarek:

Akshav nahagu haolam sheapillu im nishmetu hattepillin mimmeqoman shello bekavvana umachaziran limqoman — ap-al-pi ken en mebarekin alehem. Veyesh shennatenu taam leminhagam, shello hitzriku lachazor ulebarek ella belobesh tepillin kol hayyom venishmetu mimmeqoman shello bishat hattepilla, shello haya dato alehen kelal, abal anu sheen lobeshim otan ella bishat hattepilla, veaz missetama eno massiach dato mehem, vehu margish beshaa shennishmatin mimmeqoman, vahave leh kimzizan beatzmo mimmeqoman al menat lehachaziran miyyad limqoman, shekkebar nitbaer deeno tzarik lachazor ulebarek:

Mi sheheniach tepillin shel yad al haqqibboret uberak aleha, veachar-kak nipsaq haqqesher shel tepillin shel yad vehutzrak laasot qesher acher, omnam lo hissiach dato mehanachat hattepillin — en tzarik lachazor ulebarek al tepillin shel yad, ben shennipsaq haqqesher qodem shehiddeq hattepillin shel yad al haqqibboret, ben achar hahidduq, qodem shehiddeq et hattepillin shel rosh al rosho, dekevan shehabberaka shebberak al tepillin shel yad ola gam ken litpillin shel rosh kemo shennitbaer, veim ken kol zeman shello heniach tepillin shel rosh — adayin hu asuq bammitzva sheshshayyaka leotah beraka, umah sheasa haqqesher shel yad hu gam ken mittiqqun hammitzva sheshshayyaka leotah beraka, ki i epshar lo lehaniach tepillin shel rosh qodem tepillin shel yad, veal ken hu tzarik letaqqen hattepillin shel yad, veachar-kak yaniach shettehen karauy, venimtza dibshaa shennipsaq haqqesher adayin lo nigmera hammitzva sheshshayyaka leotah habberaka shebberak al tepillin shel yad. Lepikak eno domeh lenishmetu hattepillin mimmeqomam detzarik lachazor ulebarek keshemmachaziran limqoman, desham qodem shennishmetu mimmeqoman kebar nigmera hammitzva hashshayyaka labberaka shebberak alehem battechilla, ukeshemmachaziran limqoman — meqayyem mitzvat tepillin paam sheniyya, velaken tzarik lachazor ulebarek, abal kan mah shemmetaqqen haqqesher vechozer umeniach hattepillin shel yad karauy — eno meqayyem mitzvat tepillin paam sheniyya, ella gomer et hammitzva hashshayyaka labberaka shebberak battechilla:

Veken haddin im huttar hahidduq shel tepillin shel yad venishmat hattepillin shel yad mimmeqomah qodem shehiddeq et hattepillin shel rosh — en tzarik lachazor ulebarek keshechozer umehaddeq et hattepillin shel yad al haqqibboret, mittaam shennitbaer. Abal im leachar shehiddeq et hattepillin shel rosh al rosho nipsaq haqqesher shel tepillin shel yad ap-al-pi shello nishmeta hattepillin shel yad mimmeqomah, o shehuttar hahidduq shel tepillin shel yad ap-al-pi shello nishmeta mimmeqomah — tzarik lachazor ulebarek beshaa shemmehaddeq et hattepillin shel yad al haqqibboret:

Muttar lebarek al tepillin sheulin, mippene sheadam yotze yede chobato bitpillin shel chabero. Umin hattora adam yotze yede chobato apillu bitpillin gezulin, apillu adayin lo nityaashu habbealim mehem, sheen hattepillin tzerikin lihyot mishshello davqa. Abal chakamim paselu tepillin gezulin kol zeman shehem birshut haggazlan, apillu kebar nityaashu habbealim mehem, mippene shehi mitzva habbaa al yede abera, vehi meusa lipne haqqadosh-baruk-hu. Veim menichan — lo yebarek alehem, kevan sheen kan mitzva kelal, veal beraka zo neemar: "ubotzea berek nietz Hashem":

Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshehen adayin birshut haggazlan, abal im makar haggazlan et hattepillin leadam acher, im kebar nityaashu habbealim mehem — muttar lebarek alehem, kevan shekkebar qana otam halloqeach al yede yeush veshinnuy reshut, vahare hen keshello mammash lekol dabar, kemo shekkatub bechoshen mishpat siman shanag saip g ve-shanv saip g, im ken lo naaset hammitzva al yede abera, shehare qodem asiyyatah kebar hayu hattepillin qenuyin lalloqeach, velo haya alehen shem gazel:

Nahagu haolam shello lachalotz hattepillin ad leachar sheameru qedushshat "uba letziyyon". Veyesh mi sheomer al derek haqqabbala shetztzarik lomar bahen shelosha qaddishim, velaken en lecholtzam ad leachar qaddish shelleachar qedushshat "uba letziyyon". Vehaari"y za"l lo haya choletz ad leachar "al ken neqavveh leka". Veyesh sheen choletzim otam ad leachar qaddish yatom:
Beyom sheyyesh bo mila — en lachalotz ad leachar hammila:
Beyom sheyyesh bo qeriat hattora, vehu maqom shemmachazirin hasseper tora lahekal achar qedushshat "uba letziyyon" — nohagin shello lecholtzan ad leachar shehecheziru hasseper tora lahekal:

Bechol hammoed choletzin otan qodem qeriat hallel, beod shehashsheliach tzibbur machazir et hattepilla, vehashsheliach tzibbur choletz achar hallel. Ubechol hammoed shel sukkot, sheyyesh shehut qodem hahallel beshaa shemmokerin haetrog — gam hashsheliach tzibbur yachalotz qodem hallel:

Berosh chodesh, bimqomot sheomerim bemusap qedushshat "keter" — choletzin qodem tepillat musap belachash achar qedushshat "uba letziyyon", lepi sheen rauy lihyot muktar bitpillin beshaa sheomer "keter yittenu leka". Vaapillu bimqomot sheen omerim qedushshat "keter" bemusap — ap-al-pi-ken nohagin lecholtzan qodem tepillat musap:

Hacholetz tepillayv qodem shehecheziru hasseper tora lahekal — lo yachalotz bipne hasseper tora, ella yahapok letzad acher, delo yihyeh kebod hasseper tora garua mikkebod rabbo, sheen (talmid) choletz tepillin bepanayv, mehattaam sheyyitbaer besiman lach saip y:
